pairs.subject: background-jobs
pairs.evidence: src/components/dashboard/views/health/health-page/useSystemHealth.ts:22 The panel reads a static demo fixture once through SWR, with revalidation off and no polling, and its actions are synchronous store/cache writes, so there is no recurring loop, tick, long-running job or tracked wait for the background-jobs runtime to govern. I searched the health view directory and src/lib for refreshInterval, cancelToken, startupSweep and `new Worker` and found nothing; setInterval/heartbeat hit only unrelated src/lib modules (demoRealtime, event-bus-demo, sync/reachability, server/rate-limit) that sit outside this context.

techniques.evidence: src/hooks/useDemoOnlySWR.ts:34 The hook the panel uses turns off focus/reconnect revalidation and sets no refreshInterval, so this surface has no polling cadence to adapt.
src/components/dashboard/views/health/index.tsx:71 Configure/Install is one synchronous in-session store write plus a toast. Nothing long-running exists to need progress or a cancel.
src/components/dashboard/views/health/health-page/useSystemHealth.ts:10 The panel shows host checks taken from a fixture, not per-tick snapshots from supervised loops. No loop exists to report on.
src/lib/demoCauseFix.ts:36 Fixing a cause writes the SWR cache once per key. No timer is armed, so no roster or stop handle is needed.
src/lib/settleThread.ts:31 The thread settlement is a pure projection over fixtures. No persisted in-flight state can be orphaned across a restart.
